name: Prepare for English proficiency exams
description: Users asked for assistance in preparing for English proficiency standardized tests, primarily IELTS, by requesting high-scoring sample responses, study materials, and study plans for speaking and writing tasks. Some requests also targeted other exams such as TOEFL, PTE, or TEM4, focusing on generating model answers, practicing speaking simulations, and obtaining specific exam techniques or phrases.
